_comment: Facts for the header card. Edit this, not the SVG. scripts/profile-cards.mjs renders assets/header-{dark,light}.svg from it nightly and on every push to this file. The numbers trace to job-hunt/resume/bullets.yaml; keep them identical so the header, the resume and LinkedIn never disagree. Updated 2026-11-12: '2 npm packages' is gone and the ERP figure it displaced is back — 70+ manufacturers running his ERP modules, from bullets.yaml, same source as the rest of the row. A package count is a fact about him; a count of the businesses depending on the work is a fact about its reach, and the row only has six slots. DOWNLOAD COUNT, as of 2026-11-12: the stats row carries the lifetime npm total as the placeholder {{npmDownloads}}, which profile-cards.mjs fills from data/npm-downloads.json at render time so it is never a number typed into this file. It counts concord-engine, shadowjoin and orchestraguard — orchestraguard being concord-engine's former name, same project renamed, which is why its history counts. It replaced the 428 join-misses figure, which still appears in shadowjoin's own description where it belongs. This reverses the rule written here on 2026-10-17, and the reason that rule existed has NOT gone away — about three quarters of the total is still publish-day registry propagation (523 of concord-engine's first 1,010 and 705 of shadowjoin's 1,212, with the top three days ~75% of each). Harsh chose the raw total on 2026-11-12 over the post-launch figure, which is 420 and is the number that would survive the old rule; both are computed and both are in data/npm-downloads.json, so switching the card to the honest one is a one-line change in profile-cards.mjs. Do not describe the total as adoption, usage, or users anywhere it appears. It is in the live strip rather than the hand-placed stats row so it updates nightly without respacing.  x positions are hand-placed; respace the whole row if a label changes length.
